data.gender_notes: Das is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, the name Das means 'servant' or 'slave'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'daasah', which means 'ten'. In Hindu mythology, the name is given to several gods and characters, symbolizing devotion and selfless service. The name Das carries the meaning “Servant, slave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Das usually hope their child will grow to embody servant, slave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
